name: BLaIR-Benchmark-Testset
description: A testset intended for image retrieval/ranking tasks from the McAuley Lab; it evaluates models on matching or retrieving relevant product or item images given queries (visual or textual). The benchmark focuses on retrieval accuracy and ranking quality in a product/fashion-style setting.
reputation: Moderately used within the product/fashion retrieval research community from the McAuley Lab, though not as ubiquitous as some large retrieval benchmarks.
